rows.label: Pass defense
rows.tip: Rated on every play: EPA allowed per dropback, this season so far (counts 38% now) blended with last season. Higher = softer; rank 1 = toughest of 32. In 2023–25 ESPN’s projection for RBs moved 3.4% per sd of softer pass defense (range +2.1% to +4.9%), so a bigger role has more to move: +0.5 pts per sd on his 13.6 (range +0.3 to +0.7). After ESPN’s number the same rating explained +0.2 pts per sd (range −0.2 to +0.6) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.

rows.label: Run defense
rows.tip: Rated on every play: EPA allowed per rush, this season so far (counts 29% now) blended with last season. Higher = softer; rank 1 = toughest of 32. In 2023–25 ESPN’s projection for RBs moved 1.3% per sd of softer run defense (range −0.3% to +2.8%), so a bigger role has more to move: +0.2 pts per sd on his 13.6 (range 0.0 to +0.4). After ESPN’s number the same rating explained −0.1 pts per sd (range −0.5 to +0.4) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.

rows.label: Coverage mix
rows.tip: Each 10 points of man rate moves him −0.26 targets. Measured 2024–25, out of sample: when the game’s real coverage is known this gap is calibrated (slope 0.97, range 0.54 to 1.42). But a defense’s man rate is predictable to only about 0.05 targets (a game swings ±2.3), and the current season has no coverage tags to update it. A real trait, not a forecast.

rows.label: Early-down runner
rows.him: run defense matters more for this style
rows.tip: Measured on 8,236 player-games, 2016–25: per sd of softer run defense, early-down runners score +0.9 pts (± 0.20) against +0.3 for all-purpose and +0.2 for passing-down backs, about 4× as much. It appeared in every era (2016–19 +0.6, 2020–22 +0.9, 2023–25 +1.0) and holds among backs with a real workload. Whether ESPN prices the extra sensitivity is not known (what is left after its number is within noise), so this explains the number and does not change it.

rows.label: Role
rows.them: 24% → 48% of snaps the last two games (vs weeks 1–2).
rows.tip: From the Roles screen. Usage trends describe what changed; in backtests they added almost nothing once ESPN’s number and the consensus rankings were known.

bottom.headline: Go with ESPN’s 13.6. The matchup is already in it.
lines: SF’s pass defense is soft (23rd of 32, 1 = toughest). About +0.2 of his 13.6 is that matchup, and a normal week misses by ±7.3. The run defense is middle (15th), worth 0.0.
Once ESPN’s number was counted, the rating still explained +0.2 pts per sd in 2023–25 (range −0.2 to +0.6): nothing to add or subtract.
Not in the number: injury news, teammates who are out, weather. Check those before kickoff.
